approvalRecord.authority: historical explicit user feedback recorded by the legacy design workflow
scope: A route-stable, collapsible left sidebar adapted from the cited StarCi course-learn sidebar geometry and behavior.
The sidebar is 16rem expanded and 4rem collapsed, collapses in place, remembers collapse state, separates navigation clusters, and yields to a drawer below the large breakpoint.
The sidebar top slot carries the provision action.
The fleet leads the dashboard; work needing attention and wallet share the second row; the body remains one column with no additional 288px rail.
Sign-in keeps the previously reviewed ordering of shortcuts, divider, then credentials, with the credential form retained in the DOM for password managers.
The sign-in surface completes the second-factor challenge instead of presenting it as unsupported.
Credential refusal does not disclose the address or which credential field was wrong.

namedDecisions.decision: Complete the second-factor challenge on the sign-in screen.
Use the sidebar top slot for the provision action.
Keep the dashboard body one column beside the sidebar.

explicitlyNotApproved.statement: The case-d1 decision approved hierarchy, state ownership, and topology, not Nivo brand colors. The neutral lab palette and the StarCi Academy palette were not approved for Nivo.
